create_atomicdata_from_ase: create an AtomicData object from an ASE Atoms object with optional neighbor graph construction
convert_atomicdata_to_ase: convert an AtomicData object back to an ASE Atoms object for visualization or analysis
batch_atomicdata_list: batch a list of single-graph AtomicData objects into a single batched AtomicData object
extract_example_from_batch: extract a single AtomicData example from a batched AtomicData object by index
clone_atomicdata: create a deep copy of an AtomicData object preserving all tensor attributes and batch statistics
